name: devnet
description: How a board reaches the club, shared by both ESP images (device contract v3): the server base URL grammar, the heartbeat's net and key_next objects adopted all-or-nothing, the WiFi link supervisor, and a typed, escape-decoding reader for one JSON object's members. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for AVR, Xtensa and host.
keywords: device, network, wifi, provisioning, key rotation, embedded
